note: Disposition of every vendored upstream policy (src/policies/*.ts) in the two operative layers. The vendored tree is the PROVENANCE corpus of record; the operative enforcement surface is the app port (mcp-toolbox/apps/workflow-guard-mcp/src), and the hub/seat in-process copy (src/integrations/guard-policy) is byte-identical to the app port's portable modules (pinned by test/guard-policy-drift.test.ts). The vendored tree is NOT statically linked; no control binds it to the port except this inventory (test/guard-policy-corpus-coverage.test.ts), so a vendored policy that is not listed here fails that test.

boundary.ts.note: Workspace-boundary and shell-mutation confinement; the guard-tamper classification lives in boundary-policy.ts.

changelog.ts.missing: Only the PR-body literal-newline-escape check is ported; branch-changelog-change and lockfile-sync preflight are host-owned (they need changed-path and manifest facts the guard API does not carry).

completion.ts.note: Upstream self-describes completion claims as observability, not gating; the hub/kernel owns task completion.

continuation.ts.note: Session-continuation / Ralph orchestration is host lifecycle, outside guard_check.

destructive.ts.missing: SECURITY-RELEVANT: the destructive-command PATTERNS are ported into shell-policy.ts, but upstream's liveMutationIn scan over WRITTEN file content (extractEditContent + liveMutationIn on a file_write payload) is NOT ported. A script body that contains a live destructive command is not denied at the file_write lane.

docs.ts.note: Documentation-required preflight needs the documentation policy flag and changed paths; the hub owns it.

file-claims.ts.note: File-claim concurrency is re-implemented in the hub (src/application/workflow.ts FileClaimLedger), not in the portable guard.

git.ts.missing: Protected-branch and pointer-write parsing is ported (git-policy.ts superset of the tracker gate); repo-discovery, base-staleness, merged-branch, and merge-conflict checks need remote/repo facts and are host-owned.

interpreter.ts.missing: SECURITY-RELEVANT: interpreter payload inspection is ported, but upstream's outsideWritePathInPayload (inline interpreter script writing OUTSIDE the workspace root) and secretPathInPayload (inline interpreter reading a secret file) are NOT ported.

post-edit-validation.ts.note: Post-edit validator execution needs the host's configured commands; the hub owns it.

secrets.ts.missing: SECURITY-RELEVANT: secret-content detection (secretIn) and symlink-aware secret PATHS are ported, but upstream's secret-file READ denial lane (secretFileReadIn for shell reads of .env/secret files, and the read/read_file tool seat) is NOT ported; the port has no read action.

shell-safety.ts.note: Package hygiene, interactive-TTY detection, and shell normalization.

stale-write.ts.note: Stale-write fingerprints are owned by the hub kernel (src/application/workflow.ts matchesCurrent).

tamper.ts.note: Guard-config/host-config tamper classification by runtime-consumption facts (liveConfigPaths), fail-closed on absent facts.

todo.ts.note: Todo lifecycle and mutation budgets are owned by the hub kernel's task state; the portable guard has no todo gate.
